reason: An interactive terminal UI plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness, focused on rendering session activity and providing navigation, command panels, themes, input handling, and related display integrations.

summaries.zh: 为官方 DeepSeek Harness 提供交互式终端界面，用于展示会话事件并支持命令面板、会话导航、主题和输入管理。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal interface for the official DeepSeek Harness that displays session events and provides command panels, session navigation, themes, and input management.

capabilities: renders DeepSeek Harness session events in an interactive terminal interface
provides slash commands, selectors, panels, session navigation, and input history
persists local preferences and input history
supports clipboard image input and terminal image rendering
checks for and applies plugin updates through the package profile
